cover_headline: Sukanya Chakrabarti, Elected Fellow of the American Physical Society

end.headline: Indian-American Astrophysicist Sukanya Chakrabarti Elected Fellow of American Physical Society
end.line: The UAH professor maps dark matter by measuring the tiny accelerations it produces in stars and pulsars.

facts: APS Fellowship nominees are capped at one-half of 1% of the Society's members each year
Joined UAH in 2022 — the same year she led the first stellar-mass black hole discovery around a Sun-like star, from the Gaia mission
Her method tracks tiny accelerations in pulsars, stars and eclipsing binaries to map dark-matter clumps in the Milky Way

quote.role: Pei-Ling Chan Endowed Chair, University of Alabama in Huntsville
quote.speaker: Dr. Sukanya Chakrabarti
quote.text: We have been developing new ways to map dark matter by measuring the extraordinarily small accelerations it produces in stars throughout our Galaxy.
